|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">強力な爆発物を内蔵している。反乱軍のスパイや工作員たちの侵入を阻むため、戦術的に重要な拠点や高度の警備を要する施設の防衛線にしばしば配備される。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Infantry Mine (Dark).

'''Card text:'''
Deploy at the same exterior location as one of your mine-laying droids. It “explodes” if a character deploys or moves there. It does not explode if that movement used a vehicle or starfighter. Draw destiny. The character is lost if destiny plus 2 exceeds ability. The Infantry Mine is also lost.

'''Lore:'''
It contains a powerful explosive. To block Rebel spies and operatives, it is often placed on the defensive line of tactically important bases or high-security facilities.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese lore leads with a built-in explosive and uses 防衛線 for perimeter.
